For cutoff P with 1/(P−1)<a, any distinct eligible reduced fractions r<s have s−r>=1/[P(P−1)] by determinant arithmetic (same-denominator case stronger), r>=1/P. Strictly increasing strictly convex g(r)=tan²(pi r)/(2epsilon²) makes unique closest energy pair 1/P and 1/(P−1). Expansion yields Delta_P~pi²/(epsilon² P³). Uniform Möbius inversion counts N_P=(3a/pi²)P²+O(PlogP), and pushforward of uniform limiting r-distribution yields the displayed normalized density and edge-band probability. Independent Farey exact rational enumeration for three epsilon and up to P=97 selects the same unique pair, but infinite proof is symbolic.
